truth.what_happens: Tonight at 23:30 Nora Vale will be pushed from the loading dock of the Kestrel print shop by her business partner, Elias Brandt.
truth.why: Nora found out Elias has been moving money out of their shop account and planned to take it to the bank manager tomorrow morning.

clues.text: Kestrel Print Ltd: transfer of 4,800 to account ending 7731. Reference: 'supplies'. Third one this month.
From Nora to the bank: 'Can we meet tomorrow at 9? I think someone is emptying our business account.'
Elias to Nora: 'Heard you called the bank. Let's talk tonight at the shop, just us. 23:15?'
Nora Vale personal card: 60 at Harbour Hardware. Items: rope, heavy-duty tape.
Street camera, Dock Lane: a man in a grey work jacket enters the Kestrel back yard. Face hidden.
Elias Brandt's phone was switched off at 22:41, last located 200 m from Kestrel Print.
Tomas Reyd to Nora: 'You didn't hear it from me, but he's been asking who has keys to the dock.'

people.name: Elias Brandt
people.knows: Everything about the transfers. He set up the meeting tonight.
people.secret: He moved 14,000 out of the shop to pay a gambling debt.

lie.says: I was at home all evening, my phone died around 22:30.

people.name: Mara Quill
people.knows: Nora told her on the phone she was scared of 'a conversation at the shop tonight'.
people.secret: She borrowed money from Nora last year and never paid it back, so she avoids talking about money.

people.name: Tomas Reyd
people.knows: Elias asked him twice this week who holds the keys to the loading dock.
people.secret: He bought the rope and tape for Nora, who wanted to secure boxes on the dock; he used her card.

lie.says: I haven't bought anything for the shop this week.

explanation: The rope and tape (c4) look like Nora is planning something, but Tomas bought them for the shop. The real signal is the money: repeated transfers (c1), Nora warning the bank (c2) and Elias turning his phone off near the shop before the meeting (c7). Nora is the victim.
